mapper.select: SELECT id AS chunkId, file_id AS fileId, page_no AS pageNo, chunk_index AS chunkIndex, content AS content, MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AS score, 0 AS `rank` FROM kb_chunk WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ORDER BY score DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{topk}

SELECT id AS chunkId, file_id AS fileId, page_no AS pageNo, chunk_index AS chunkIndex, content AS content, 0 AS score, 0 AS `rank` FROM kb_chunk WHERE id IN
#{id}

SELECT id AS chunkId, file_id AS fileId, page_no AS pageNo, chunk_index AS chunkIndex, content AS content, 0 AS score, 0 AS `rank` FROM kb_chunk WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND chunk_index BETWEEN #{startChunkIndex} AND #{endChunkIndex} ORDER BY chunk_index ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
